## Tooling

Nothing in the sidebar changed. This release moves publishing into CI, which is what
prompted it: `v0.6.0` and `v0.6.1` both shipped with tags but no GitHub release, because
the step lived only in someone's head.

Releasing is now a commit and a push. The `release` job waits for the build, tests,
clippy, and fmt to pass, checks the commit subject against the version in `Cargo.toml`,
then tags and publishes from a notes file committed alongside the bump. On any other
commit it stops at that check. Both publishing steps skip work already done, so re-running
a job that died halfway finishes it rather than erroring.

The repo also gained an `.envrc`, so direnv loads the devShell on entering the directory,
and a `make build` target for the local release build.

## Install

### Nix flake

```nix
# Pin to a release tag (recommended); drop the ref to track the default branch.
inputs.tmux-legion.url = "github:hawkish/tmux-legion/v0.6.2";
```

### Manual and TPM-style

```bash
git clone https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion
cd ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion && cargo build --release
echo 'run-shell ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion/tmux-legion.tmux' >> ~/.tmux.conf
```

Upgrading needs a tmux config reload, not just a rebuild — see [After upgrading](https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion#after-upgrading). The [README](https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion#install) covers Claude Code hooks, the agent skill, and the pi extension.
